## Summary

What does this PR do and why? One or two sentences. Link the issue or design
doc it implements.

## Changes

- Bullet list of the user-visible or behavior changes
- Group related edits; omit pure refactors unless they matter

## Test plan

- [ ] Added or updated unit tests for the change
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] `cd desktop && npm test` passes
- [ ] Manually verified the behavior in the desktop shell (if applicable)

## Risk and rollback

- Risk level: low / medium / high
- How to roll back if needed (revert, feature flag, config change, etc.)

## Linked issues / docs

Closes #... or links to the relevant design doc in `docs/`.
